environment.working_tree: untracked ERP implementation docs; no production code changes

decisions.summary: One Products master covers finished products, raw materials/components and services; semimanufactured items remain deferred.
Product class is independent of purchasing, selling and inventory-tracking uses.
The product base has one general category; each separately managed/sold SKU has its own primary category, which may differ from the base and sibling variants.
Buy/make/both sourcing is product-owned and inherited by variants.
A variant is a specific product managed or sold separately, with its own SKU distinct from sibling variants.
Each variant/SKU has its own independently assigned category; the product base retains a general category and SKU categories may differ.
Products and categories are organization-scoped and shared across workspaces; legacy workspace IDs need migration handling.

Product, variant and category keys are LoopDev-generated, immutable, distinct from SKU/name and unique organization-wide. SKU uniqueness is organization-wide after trimming outer whitespace and comparing case-insensitively while preserving entered case.

Only legacy service maps automatically to Service; physical_product, digital_product, subscription, coverage, package and fee remain drafts until explicitly reviewed. Legacy categoryKey mapping remains open.
A draft product/SKU may omit category; a category is required before activation.

Archive preserves existing assignments and blocks new ones; permanent deletion is prohibited; restore and subtree-preserving reparent rules are confirmed; archiving is blocked while active children remain.
Finished products allow buy/make/both; raw materials/components are buy-only for now; services have no sourcing value. Revisit raw-material sourcing during Manufacturing discovery.
OrganizationCatalog is migration-only, not a target business entity or product-ownership boundary.
Commercial price currency is owned by each PriceBook; migrate the legacy OrganizationCatalog currency into applicable books.
Define mapping of legacy categoryKey references to organization-scoped ProductCategory keys.
Assign target-domain owners and migration mappings for legacy OrganizationCatalog locale and channel fields.
Each PriceEntry uses the currency of its PriceBook; legacy PriceEntry.currency is not an independent target value.
Offer has no independent currency; offer prices use the currency of their associated PriceBook.
